formal_statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj],
    (∀ a b c : Fin n, ¬ (G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c a)) →
    (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ¬ (G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a)) →
    ∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v →
      (∀ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj v w),
        ∀ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj v w), ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj u w),
        ∀ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj u w), ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj v w ∧ w ≠ u) ∪
              Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj u w ∧ w ≠ v),
        ∀ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj v w ∧ w ≠ u) ∪
              Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.Adj u w ∧ w ≠ v), ¬ G.Adj a b)
plain_statement: In a finite simple graph with no triangle and no 4-cycle, for every edge uv: the neighbours of v are pairwise non-adjacent, the neighbours of u are pairwise non-adjacent, and the neighbours of v other than u together with the neighbours of u other than v are pairwise non-adjacent.
title: Around an edge of a graph with no triangle and no 4-cycle, the neighbourhoods are independent (standalone text)
